abstract: BACKGROUND: We aimed to identify clinical characteristics of ovarian mature cystic teratoma (MCT) in association with CA19-9 elevation, and to determine if CA19-9 is a useful marker in discrimination of MCT from ovarian cancer (OC). MATERIAL AND METHODS: Medical records of 322 women with pathologically-confirmed MCT or OC (stage 1 or 2) were reviewed retrospectively. The relationships between the characteristics of MCT (mean diameter, bilaterality, and pathologic components) and elevated CA19-9 were evaluated. Tumor markers in MCT were compared to those in OC. RESULTS: MCTs with CA19-9 elevation were correlated with a larger diameter (8.53±3.84 cm vs. 6.95±3.97 cm, p=0.002) and presence of fat component (67.1% vs. 32.9%, p<0.001), compared to those with normal CA 19-9. Although the incidence of CA19-9 elevation was not different between patients with MCT and OC (p=0.700), the mean value of CA19-9 was higher in those with OC (114.66±20.66 U/mL vs. 508.58±261.63 U/mL, p=0.013). In addition, simultaneous elevation of CA125 and CA19-9 was associated with a higher probability of malignant neoplasm (p<0.001; odds ratio: 23.7; 95% confidence interval: 8.863-63.576) than single elevation of CA 19-9. CONCLUSIONS: CA19-9 could be an important tool in the diagnosis of ovarian mature cystic teratoma. CA19-9, in combination with CA125, might be a useful marker in discrimination of MCT from cancer.
abstract_ja: 背景：卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(MCT)におけるCA19-9上昇に関連する臨床的特徴を明らかにし、CA19-9がMCTと卵巣癌(OC)の鑑別に有用な腫瘍マーカーであるかを検討することを目的とした。対象と方法：病理学的に確定したMCTまたはOC（ステージ1または2）の女性322例の診療記録を後方視的に検討した。MCTの特徴（平均径、両側性、病理学的成分）とCA19-9上昇との関連を評価した。MCTの腫瘍マーカーをOCのものと比較した。結果：CA19-9上昇を伴うMCTは、正常CA19-9のMCTと比較して、径が大きく（8.53±3.84cm vs. 6.95±3.97cm、p=0.002）、脂肪成分を有すること（67.1% vs. 32.9%、p<0.001）と関連していた。MCTとOCの間でCA19-9上昇の頻度に差はなかった(p=0.700)が、CA19-9の平均値はOCで高かった（114.66±20.66 U/mL vs. 508.58±261.63 U/mL、p=0.013）。また、CA125とCA19-9の同時上昇は、単独のCA19-9上昇と比べて悪性腫瘍である確率が高かった（p<0.001；オッズ比23.7；95%信頼区間8.863-63.576）。結論：CA19-9は卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の診断において重要な指標となりうる。CA19-9をCA125と併用することは、MCTと癌の鑑別に有用なマーカーとなりうる。
